### Gravel Style

These pages have filters for material, suspension correction, UDH compatibility, sliding dropout, handlebar (flat or drop), axle spacing, and maximum tire width.

A table of the [classification of all gravel bike models in the database into Racy, Relaxed, and Rowdy categories](qmd/gravel_class.qmd) 

A single plot that [compares overall similarity of frame geometry among gravel bikes](qmd/gravel_mds.qmd), color coded by style

### Gravel Bike Comparison Tools

A table to [compare up to three bikes on key frame geometry measures and frame specs](qmd/test_bike_comparison.qmd) 

[Plots of specific frame measures](qmd/gravel_scatter.qmd) for all gravel bike models and frame sizes in the database.

### How does my bike frame geometry change if I add suspension?

See [how your bike frame's geometry changes with a suspension fork](qmd/gravel_sus_fork.qmd).

See [how your bike frame's relative similarity to other bikes changes with a suspension fork](qmd/gravel_scatter_sus.qmd).

### A Tree Diagram of frame similarity

The [Gravel Tree](qmd/gravel_tree.qmd) page contains a tree diagram showing the relative similarity in frame geometry among all gravel bikes in the database and the clustering of the models into three major styles.
